english.title: Assist in non-compliance with freezing order - Terrorism
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) engaged in an activity, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ACTIVITY..), knowing or intending that it would enable or facilitate another person, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..), not to comply with a prohibition, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PROHIBITION BREACHED..), imposed by a freezing order made under Part 2 of the Anti-terrorism, Crime and Security Act 2001
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph 7(3) and (6) of Schedule 3 to the Anti-Terrorism, Crime and Security Act 2001.
english.pointstoprove:
engaged in an activity
knowing/intending that it would
enable/facilitate another person
not to comply with a prohibition
imposed by a freezing order

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) The penalty for this offence has changed from Indictable 2 years imprisonment to now 7 years imprisonment, this is with effect from 1/4/17. If this offence has been committed on or after this date then use H18854 CJS Code AT01045.
(ii) The consent of the Director of Public Prosecutions or the Treasury MAY be required - see paragraph 8 of Schedule 3 to the Act.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Six months imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Two years imprisonment and/or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
